lessons_used: Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 3 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, and 7), though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 5, and 8).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 5 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8).
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
home notification changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 2 and 6).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, and choose_path redesign due to disagreeing outcomes, as well as for all kinds of change with only a single test.

candidates.title: Desktop Tray & Shortcut Setup Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated onboarding screen at the finish step showing hotkeys, tray icon controls, and desktop pet visibility toggles.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets highlighted post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to the desktop pet.

new_tray_setup.headline: Desktop Pet Quick Controls
new_tray_setup.body: Use system tray icon or shortcut keys to toggle visibility, interact, or open pet settings anytime.

guard.reason: Adding a setup screen after home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Adding a new screen at finish has historically decreased conversion (-2.9% average across 3 tests).

candidates.title: Multi-Step Adoption Certificate Stage Layout
candidates.change: Redesign adoption_certificate into a interactive stage layout with clear step counter, custom name input, and preview card.
candidates.why: Adoption stage is the biggest drop-off point with only 66.2% conversion and a 1017s mean duration.

guard.reason: 'adoption_certificate.replace.certificate[1]': a name_input cannot do the certificate job (use ['animation', 'badge', 'image', 'preview', 'text'])

candidates.title: Deferred Account Sign-In Flow
candidates.change: Move sign-in after pet adoption choices so users customize their pet before signing in to save it.
candidates.why: Signing in early (80.1% conversion) before creating a pet reduces motivation. Moving auth later leverages commitment consistency.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after pet adoption choices is explicitly permitted.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in step previously resulted in a significant drop (-7.0%).

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Spawn Calibration Flow
candidates.change: Introduce a calibration step during render waiting that lets users test pet placement and screen overlay settings.
candidates.why: Home wait time averages 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on desktop or app failing to launch properly.

new_spawn_calibration.headline: Calibrating Screen Overlay
new_spawn_calibration.body: Select preferred desktop corner and display boundary settings while your pet finishes rendering.

guard.reason: Adding a calibration screen during onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: New flows carry high friction and cost, with poor performance historical trends.

candidates.title: Path Commitment Time Expectation Headline
candidates.change: Clarify total expected onboarding time and pet setup steps in the story welcome screen header.
candidates.why: Mean time spent on choose_path is 514s despite 8s median, showing long tail hesitation when choosing a path.

story.headline: Create Your Desktop Companion in Under 3 Minutes
story.body: Pick your favorite pet style, customize its look, and sign in to keep your pet synced across all your devices.

guard.reason: Updating story copy to provide setup time expectations is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak targeting heavy drop-off/hesitation, previous test showed positive lift.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Idle Activity Stream
candidates.change: Display a tip carousel of pet animations and idle behavior previews on the waiting screen while rendering.
candidates.why: Waiting stage median is 201s and mean is 2336s. Wait info enhancements consistently won in rounds 3, 4, and 7.

components.text: Your pet loves chasing cursor icons and sleeping near active windows!

guard.reason: Adding tip carousel information to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes are well-proven with 3 winning tests and consistent positive average lift.

candidates.title: Cloud Account Sync Safeguard Hint
candidates.change: Display a explicit data preservation hint explaining account sign-in prevents pet loss on reinstallation.
candidates.why: 8 support emails (the top issue category) complained about pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Signing in links your pet to cloud storage so your pet progress is never lost if you reinstall or switch PCs.

guard.reason: Adding an explanatory cloud sync hint to the sign-in screen is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Strongest evidence combination: top support complaint (8 emails) and proven sign_in hint track record.

candidates.title: Pet Adoption Certificate Milestone Badge
candidates.change: Add an interactive celebratory mascot and completion badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption completion rate drops to 66.2%. Rewarding users at certificate creation boosts motivation to finish.

guard.reason: Adding celebratory components to the adoption certificate screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Targets the worst funnel step (adoption 66.2%), though component redesigns have mixed past results.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Status Completion Notification
candidates.change: Enable desktop completion notification prompt on home_intro when pet setup finishes in background.
candidates.why: Finish screen mean time is high (5815s), suggesting users switch windows and miss completion.

home_intro.hint: We'll notify you when your pet is ready to wander across your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding notification prompts to home_intro inside onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Addresses huge mean delay (5815s) at finish, but notification changes show modest overall impact.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Carousel Layout
candidates.change: Update upload_photos layout to carousel format with explicit photo quality picker controls.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or visual artifacts during photo upload step.

guard.reason: Asks for personal photos of the user

picked: Interactive Desktop Pet Idle Activity Stream

decisions.title: Interactive Desktop Pet Idle Activity Stream

shipped: Interactive Desktop Pet Idle Activity Stream
lessons_next: Predictions overall tended to overestimate positive impact (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in key winning tests during rounds 3, 4, and 6.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 4 winning tests (rounds 3, 4, 7, and 9), though 3 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 5, and 8).
sign_in hint changes can be helpful, backed by 2 winning tests (rounds 4 and 6), though 5 tests showed no clear effect (rounds 1, 2, 5, 7, and 8).
choose_path layout changes (rounds 1, 5) and home notification changes (rounds 2, 6) consistently showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests each.
sign_in reorder changes proved harmful, leading to a guardrail rollback in round 3 and a negative result in round 9.

Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign, choose_path copy, choose_path redesign, finish new_flow, finish new_screen, and all single-test kinds of change due to disagreeing outcomes or insufficient tests.
